basic_info.description: Spacious home in sought-after Ingleside Terraces with lots of room and character! Owners have made many improvements including brand new exterior stucco, all new windows, and updated bathrooms. Large bedrooms and generous living areas offer comfort and flexibility for today’s lifestyle. The home features a nice backyard with plenty of potential for entertaining or gardening. Fantastic location near Stonestown Galleria, Whole Foods, and the charming Ocean Avenue shops and cafés. Close to top-rated schools including Lowell High, MUNI, and easy freeway access. A great opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of San Francisco’s most convenient neighborhoods.
